texts.preamble: (Binodilal Agarwal & Anr vs The State Of West Bengal & Anr.) on 25 September, 2025 2509 In The High Court At Calcutta Criminal Revisional Jurisdiction 2025 Thursday Crr 1102 Of 2014
texts.arguments: Mr. Chattoraj, learned Advocate representing the petitioner, submits that the complaint on which the case being O2 D of 2011 was initiated against the petitioner was lodged in the year 2011. Referring to the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 (hereinafter referred to as the Act of 2006), he submits that in view of the provisions of Section 97 of the Act of 2006, all the Acts referred to in the schedule appended to the Act of 2006 have been repealed. He further submits that the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954 was incorporated in the schedule of the Act of 2006. Referring to the Notification dated 29.07.2010, he submits that the effect of Section 97 of the Act of 2006 was to be given to from the date of publication of that Notification, i.e., 29.07.2010. Therefore, according to him, on the date of initiation of the proceeding, the enactment, namely the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954, was not in force, and consequently, the authority proceeded against the petitioner under a repealed enactment. He submits that this issue was raised before the Trial Court as well as before the Appellate Court; however, both courts have overlooked this issue and arrived at an erroneous finding. He submits that the petitioner has a fair chance to succeed in this revisional application.
